name: poissfit
expr: [lh_b, lci_b] = poissfit(x); [lh_z, lci_z] = poissfit(xz); [lh_a, lci_a] = poissfit(x, 0.01); [lh_e, lci_e] = poissfit([]);
comment: Sig: [lhat, lci] = poissfit(x[, alpha]). MLE for Poisson: lambda=mean(x). Exact CI via chi² inversion (Garwood). Edges: all-zero data -> lo=0; non-default alpha; empty input -> NaN.
